stories.title: Economists expect RBI to tighten monetary policy
stories.summary: Retail inflation rose to 6.09 percent in October, the highest level since the new CPI series began. Economists expect the Reserve Bank of India to raise the repo rate to 6 percent by February. Price pressures remain elevated despite expectations that inflation may have largely peaked.

stories.title: Fresh bank lending rates decline in September
stories.summary: Fresh lending rates fell 10 basis points to 8.51 percent in September, while deposit rates dropped 6 basis points to 5.61 percent. Foreign banks led the reductions, cutting rates by 22 basis points. Surplus liquidity helped banks narrow the spread on fresh business to 2.90 percent.

stories.title: November inflation may hit 6.3 percent
stories.summary: India's consumer inflation is tracking close to 6.3 percent in November with an upward bias, according to a Union Bank of India report. The bank expects the Reserve Bank of India to raise the repo rate by 25 basis points in December. The food price trend remains a variable.

stories.title: Food inflation risks prompt rate hike warnings
stories.summary: ICICI Bank expects the Reserve Bank of India to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in December and February due to elevated food inflation. The outlook depends on the upcoming rabi crop, as lower reservoir levels and soil moisture continue to pressure prices for cereals and edible oils.

stories.title: Loan fraud targets students in Salem
stories.summary: Two individuals have been arrested in Salem for allegedly using students' personal details to facilitate unauthorized loan transactions. The incident highlights the risks students face when sharing identity documents for financial offers. Authorities are now emphasizing the importance of keeping personal financial information secure from seemingly lucrative schemes.

stories.title: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund reduces cash holdings
stories.summary: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund, India's largest actively managed equity mutual fund, has reduced its cash allocation from a 25 percent peak to 8.78 percent as of October 2026. The fund, which manages over 1.46 lakh crore rupees, had faced scrutiny for its performance and high cash levels.

stories.title: Mutual funds increase exposure to Nifty stocks
stories.summary: Mutual funds were net buyers in 32 of the 50 Nifty stocks during October 2026, according to Motilal Oswal Financial Services. The buying trend also extended to 62 percent of Nifty Midcap 100 constituents and 61 percent of Nifty Smallcap 100 constituents. Fund managers are shifting their portfolio allocations accordingly.

stories.title: Sundar Pichai tops HSBC Hurun Global Indians list
stories.summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai leads the 2026 HSBC Hurun Global Indians list, which tracks leaders of Indian origin heading companies outside India. The list recognizes 236 executives across 200 companies. Hurun India noted that 125 of the individuals on the list did not found the companies they currently lead.

research.title: RepoMech: A Method to Reduce the Balance-Sheet Impact of Repo Intermediation
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: A repo trade involves the sale of a security coupled with a contract to repurchase at a later time. Following the 2008 financial crisis, accounting standards were updated to require repo intermediaries, who are mostly banks. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the impact of generative AI on labor market signaling using the introduction of an AI-powered cover letter writing tool on a large online labor platform. Our data track both access to the tool and. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: The Rebundling of Freelance Work in the AI Age
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper examines how freelance work is changing in the AI era. We compare the activities people undertake in ChatGPT with the work clients request on Upwork, an online freelance platform, and examine how clients combine. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: The amplifier effect of artificial agents in social contagion
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Individuals and organizations increasingly consider delegating decision-making to AI agents, which may significantly alter social contagion dynamics. We ask whether artificial agents exhibit different adoption thresholds from those of human subjects when making decisions and, if. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Unequal Rewards and the Direction of Scientific Work: Evidence from U.S. Public Universities

Tournament theory expects stronger effort, while social comparison accounts expect withdrawal. Both perspectives, however, treat performance as a single scale on which. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
